title: Deferred versus Immediate scale-up
provenance: Real ComputeNextStep output from the cited commit, verified by validateUpdateStep and the independent assertScalingSafety oracle. Readiness and completed old deletions are simulated; ticks are not measured time. No Kubernetes e2e run.

Independent scale-up policy, merged in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/lws/pull/1225. Source: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/lws/blob/7f56f55c0962109e5b3129cf8921c7002deb4310/pkg/controllers/disaggregatedset/planner.go . Scale-down remains Deferred.
Panels are aligned to simulated ticks with equal per-group startup delay, not wall-clock duration. Tile IDs are illustration identities, not Kubernetes Pod UIDs.

source.format: Finite Canvas primitives, original state boundaries, 24fps sampled decorative motion. No domain calculations at playback.
